select from market_pulse_capture_batches where deleted_at is null and trade_date = #{tradeDate} order by fetched_at desc nulls last, updated_at desc nulls last limit 1

select id, trade_date, name, rank_by_change, change_pct, valid_size, sample_size, source, payload, ingested_at, updated_at, deleted_at from mkt_style_sector_snapshot where deleted_at is null and name = #{name} order by trade_date desc limit 1

select id, snapshot_date, kind, source, payload, item_count, generated_at, created_at, updated_at, deleted_at from mkt_heatmap_snapshot where deleted_at is null and kind = #{kind} order by snapshot_date desc, generated_at desc nulls last limit 1

select id, trade_date, limit_up_count, limit_down_count, touched_count, broken_count, break_board_rate, max_streak_height, promotion_overall_rate, sentiment_level, sentiment_text, stock_count, market_status, data_status, source, extra, created_at, updated_at, deleted_at from market_limit_daily_snapshots where deleted_at is null and trade_date = #{tradeDate} order by updated_at desc nulls last limit 1

select id, trade_date, limit_up_count, limit_down_count, touched_count, broken_count, break_board_rate, max_streak_height, promotion_overall_rate, sentiment_level, sentiment_text, stock_count, market_status, data_status, source, extra, created_at, updated_at, deleted_at from market_limit_daily_snapshots where deleted_at is null and trade_date <= #{tradeDate} order by trade_date desc, updated_at desc nulls last limit 1

select stocks.id, stocks.trade_date, stocks.code, coalesce(nullif(stocks.name, ''), basic.name) as name, stocks.category, stocks.streak, stocks.change_pct, stocks.limit_up_price, stocks.limit_down_price, stocks.created_at, stocks.updated_at, stocks.deleted_at from market_limit_daily_stocks stocks left join sec_stock_basic basic on basic.code = stocks.code where stocks.deleted_at is null and stocks.trade_date = #{tradeDate} and stocks.category = #{category} order by stocks.streak desc nulls last, stocks.change_pct desc nulls last limit #{limit}

select from mkt_index_return_daily where deleted_at is null and window_days = #{windowDays} and trade_date = ( select max(trade_date) from mkt_index_return_daily where deleted_at is null and window_days = #{windowDays} ) order by index_name
select from mkt_index_return_daily where deleted_at is null and index_code = #{indexCode} order by trade_date desc, window_days asc limit 1
